title: DECLARE THIS SCRIPTURES EVERY MORNING BEFORE GOING OUT
text: Stop whatever you are doing for the next few minutes because I'm not going to give you a sermon this morning. [music] I'm going to hand you a weapon and if you receive it correctly, you will never walk out of your front door the same unguarded way again. Something woke me up before my alarm today. A sentence sharp, urgent, repeating itself until I sat up in the dark and wrote it down so I would not lose it before the sun came up. The sentence was this. My children are leaving their houses naked. Not physically naked, spiritually naked. Walking into traffic, into offices, into markets, into rooms full of strangers [music] without a single word of the living God loaded into their mouths and then wondering why the day at them alive. I felt the spirit of God grieve this morning. Not angry, grieved [music] the way a father is grieved. Watching a child walk toward danger, he has already warned them about a hundred times. So before you scroll past this, before you rush into your Monday or your Tuesday or whatever ordinary day this finds you in, I need you to sit down with me for a few minutes. Because what I'm about to give you is not decoration for your spiritual [music] life. It is armor. And nobody's saying walks into a battlefield without armor simply [music] because the battlefield is familiar. Somebody reading this has been leaving the house on nothing but coffee and complaint for [music] months. No word in your mouth, no declaration over your day, just vibes and hope. And then you wonder why the day pushes you around like it owns you. Today that changes. [music] Today we are going back to a discipline the old saints never negotiated on. And [music] I want to teach it to you properly before I release you into a full atmosphere of prayer and declaration because information without impartation just becomes [music] another thing you knew but never did. Turn your attention, even if [music] it is just the attention of your spirit, to Psalm 5:3. My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, oh Lord, in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up. Notice the specific word direct. David did not simply pray in the morning the way a man mutters something vague before rushing out the door. He directed his prayer the way an archer directs an arrow. The way a captain directs a ship with intention with aim with a target in mind. Directed prayer in the morning is not a devotional nicity. It is [music] target setting for your entire day before the day has a chance to set [music] its own targets on you. I want you to catch something else buried in that verse. He said in the morning will I direct my prayer and will look up. Look up. Not look around at the mess on your kitchen table. Not look down at your phone and the 17 notifications already stressing you before your feet even touch the floor. Look up. There is something about the posture of looking up that resets your entire orientation before the world gets a chance to pull your eyes downward into its noise. There is a second scripture I want to plant next to this one. Because revelation is established by two or three witnesses, not by a single verse pulled out to make a point. Lamentations 3 22 and 23. It is of the Lord's mercies that we are not consumed because his [music] compassions fail not. They are new every morning. Great is thy faithfulness. Somebody needs to hear this before anything else I say today. Whatever tried to consume you yesterday did not succeed. And the reason it did not succeed was not your own strength. It [music] was mercy. Fresh mercy. Morning mercy. Mercy manufactured brand new for you before you even opened your eyes. This is why declaring scripture in the morning is not a religious performance. It is an act of receiving what has already been freshly supplied. [music] You are not begging God for something reluctant. You are collecting something that was already prepared for [music] you at done. the way mana was prepared fresh every single morning for Israel in the wilderness. And anyone who tried to hoard yesterday's mana found it bread worms and stank according to Exodus 16:20. Yesterday's grace will not carry today's assignment. You need fresh mercy, fresh direction, fresh fire, and it is sitting there every single morning waiting for you to open your mouth [music] and receive it through the spoken word. Let me preach this a little further before we move into declaration [music] because I feel something rising that wants room to breathe. There is a reason the enemy targets your morning specifically. And if you have never noticed this pattern, notice it now. The worst arguments in a home often [music] start before breakfast. The heaviest oppression on a person's mind often lands the moment they wake. Sometimes even before conscious thought fully returns. the accidents, the sudden bad news, phone calls, the missed opportunities, so much of it seems to cluster in these early hours. And that is not a coincidence. That is strategy. Whoever governs the opening of your day [music] tends to govern the direction of your day. And if you surrender that opening hour to silence, to scrolling, to anxious, rushing, you have handed the enemy the steering wheel before you even said good morning to your own soul. I decree over you right now before I even finish teaching that from this day the enemy loses his grip on your mornings. I decree that the first voice you hear each day is the voice of the Lord and not the voice of your own anxiety rehearsing yesterday's failures. Somebody shout it with me. My mornings belong to God not to fear. Let me take you deeper into scripture because I want you to see that this is not new fangled prayer culture. This is ancient pattern established long before any of us were born. Job 22:28 says, [music] "Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee, [music] and the light shall shine upon thy ways." Decree, not hope, not wish, not casually mentioned to God as a suggestion. Decree, that word carries the weight of a legal proclamation. The kind a king issues that cannot be quietly ignored by his subjects. [music] When you decree scripture over your day, you are not performing a spiritual exercise for your own comfort. You are issuing a legally binding proclamation in the courts of the spirit realm. And the promise attached to that decree is specific. It shall be established and light shall shine upon your ways. I want you to notice the connection between decree and light. Established decree [music] produces illuminated pathway. This tells me that many of you have been stumbling through decisions, through relationships, through business moves, not because you lack intelligence, but because you have been walking a dark path that a [music] simple decree could have lit up before you took a single step. Proverbs 18:21 settles this even further. Death and life are in the power of the tongue, and they that love it shall eat the food thereof. Your tongue is not a passive organ reporting on [music] your circumstances. It is an active organ producing your circumstances. And if you have been silent every morning, do not be surprised that your days have felt directionless. Because silence produces nothing. But a decreed word produces a harvest according [music] to its kind. Here is a picture the Holy Spirit gave me while I was praying earlier. [music] Imagine a farmer who owns fatile, generous soil. soil that has never once failed to produce whatever is planted in it. But this farmer wakes up every morning, [music] looks at his field, size, and walks away without planting a single seed. At the end of the season, he stands in an empty field [music] complaining that life has been unfair to him. That farmer is not a victim of bad soil. He's a victim of his own silence. Your mouth is that fertile soil. And every single morning that you leave the house without planting a decreed word into your day is a morning you walk past a harvest that was fully available to you. Somebody needs to repent right now. Not with shame but with holy determination for every morning wasted in silence [music] when a decree could have shifted the atmosphere of an entire day. Lord forgive us for treating our mouths like decoration instead of like seed. from today we plant. Let the declarations begin to rise because teaching alone will not change your Tuesday morning. Only a decreed word will repeat this after me out loud if you can whisper if that is all you have right now. But [music] say it. I decree according to Psalm 118:24. [music] This is the day which the Lord hath made. I will rejoice and be glad in it. And no report the enemy tries to hand me today will steal that joy. I decree according to Isaiah 54:17, "No weapon formed against me today shall prosper. And every tongue that rises against me in judgment [music] I shall condemn. I decree according to Psalm 91 that I dwell under the shadow of the Almighty today and no pestilence, no plague, no sudden calamity has legal access to my life. I decree according to Deuteronomy 28:13 that I am the head today and not the tail, above only and not beneath. In every meeting, every negotiation, every room I walk into, [music] I decree according to Psalm 90:17, "Let the beauty of the Lord my God be upon me [music] today, and establish the work of my hands. Yay, the work of my hands establish thou it." Say it louder now because your voice matters in this. Today belongs to me because God already gave it to me. I want to bring you into a scripture that will steady you for the rest of this world. Because I know some of you reading this are heading into a day that genuinely terrifies you. A meeting you have dreaded. A diagnosis you are waiting on. A conversation you have postponed for weeks because you do not know how it will end. Psalm 27:1 meets you exactly there. The Lord is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? The Lord is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid? This is not a denial of the size of what you are facing. It is a redirection of your gaze away from the size of the threat [music] toward the size of the one standing with you. Fear is not defeated by pretending the enemy is small. [music] Fear is defeated by [singing] declaring out loud every single morning that God is [music] bigger. Let us move now into the place of prayer because this word was never meant to end as a lecture you not belong to. It is meant to become a daily discipline you carry [music] into every sunrise for the rest of your life. Stand up if you are able. Lift your hands and let us begin to pray this morning. Declaration over destiny first because a day without direction is simply a day wasted with extra steps. Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for the gift of this new morning. And I ask that you would establish the steps of everyone connected to this word. According to Psalm 37:23, the steps of a good man are ordered by the Lord, and he delightth in his way. I decree over every scattered, confused, aimless morning routine represented here, order is coming. I decree that from today before your feet touch the floor, your spirit reaches first [music] for direction, not distraction. I speak to every destiny that has been [music] drifting without a decreed word to anchor it. I decree according to Jeremiah 29:11 that the thoughts God thinks [music] toward you are thoughts of peace and not of evil to give you an expected end. And I declare that expected end is now being pulled closer to you every single morning. That you open your mouth and agree with heaven's plan instead of yesterday's disappointment. Let there be a shout in this place. My destiny answers to the word of God, not to the mood of my Monday. Now let us move into family because whatever happens in your house before you leave often determines the temperature you carry into everywhere else you go that day. Father, I decree peace over every household connected to this word. This morning I decree according to Joshua 24:15, "As for me and my house, we will serve the Lord." That every argument the enemy tries to spark before breakfast [music] is silenced. That every child leaving for school today is covered by angelic escort. And that every spouse walking out that door carries peace instead of tension into their workplace. >> [music] >> I decree that the atmosphere of every home represented here shifts this morning from rushed and irritable to calm and covered. I decree that the last words spoken in every household before everyone scatters for the day are words of blessing, not words of frustration. [music] Because Proverbs 18:21 is still governing this entire prayer. and I refuse to let careless morning words plant seeds of strife that we will be reaping arguments from by evening. Let us pray now specifically for marriages because I know some of you are walking out the door this morning still carrying yesterday's unresolved tension with the person sleeping beside you. Father, in the name of Jesus, I decree reconciliation over every strained marriage connected to this word. I decree according to Ecclesiastes 4:12 that a three-fold cord is not quickly broken. And I call the Lord himself into the middle of every marriage represented here as that unbreakable third strand. I decree that pride does not win the morning. That the first person willing to say I am sorry receive supernatural grace to say it before the sun rises much higher. and that no small offense is allowed to calcify into a permanent wall between husband and wife. Somebody declare with me, my marriage will not lose today to silence and pride. Let us move into finances because so many of you are walking into rooms today, offices, markets, negotiations where money is on the line and I refuse to let you walk in their empty mouth. Father, I decree open financial gates over everyone connected to this word today. [music] I decree according to Malachi 3:10 that the windows of heaven are opened and blessing is poured out that there shall not be room enough to [music] receive it. I decree that every meeting scheduled for today that involves money moves in your favor. That every negotiation tilts toward increase and that no financial door assigned to open for you today is delayed by a spirit of lack that has attached itself to your household in previous [music] seasons. I decree over every business owner connected to this word, [music] your customers find you today. I decree over every job seeker, your interview goes better than you rehearsed it in your head. I decree over every entrepreneur waiting on a delayed payment. Today the delay breaks. I want to pause and speak directly to something that quietly undoes many good mornings before the prayer even ends. And that is the temptation to check your phone the instant your eyes open [music] before a single decreed word has left your mouth. I am not condemning technology. I use it too. But I want you to notice what happens when the first input of your day is someone else's opinion, someone else's crisis, someone else's headline before you have given your own spirit the chance to speak first. You end up starting your day reacting to the world instead of declaring over it. And reaction is a weaker posture [music] than declaration. Every single time I decree a new order over your morning starting today, mouth before screen, word before world, declaration before distraction. Let health be our next altar of prayer. Because you cannot carry declared scripture into a day [music] if your body is being sabotaged by sickness. The enemy hoped you would simply accept as normal. Father, I decree divine health over everybody connected to this word this morning. I decree according to Exodus 15:26, [music] I am the Lord that healed thee over every ache, every unexplained pain, every fatigue that has been quietly wearing you down without a proper name. I decree strength renewed like the eagles according to Isaiah 40:31. And I decree that no sickness gets to write the story of today over anyone who has spoken this word out loud this morning. I want to slow down here because there is [music] a category of morning attack that most believers never learn to recognize until they have already lost hours of their day to it. And that is the attack that comes through inherited covenants and hidden altars. [music] Some of you wake up already tired, already anxious, already dreading the day before anything has even gone wrong. And that heaviness did not start with you this morning. >> [music] >> It started generations ago at an altar you never visited [music] through a covenant you never signed but somehow still carry. Father, in the name of Jesus, [music] I break every inherited covenant assigned to greet me the moment I wake. I decree according to Galatians 3:13, Christ had redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a cause for us, that every generational pattern of morning heaviness, morning dread, and morning delay is severed permanently from [music] this day forward. I decree that every evil altar assigned to monitor my movements the moment I step outside my door is located and set ablaze by the fire of the Holy Ghost. I decree that no ritual performed against my name in the [music] dark hours before dawn has legal standing over my daylight hours. Whatever [music] was buried, whatever was spoken, whatever was offered on my behalf without my consent, I reject it. I renounce it and I declare it null and void in the name of Jesus. Let a shout rise here. [music] Every evil altar assigned to my morning catch fire now. Now let us call in angelic reinforcement because you were never meant to walk into your day alone. However empty the sidewalk looks or however quiet the office feels when you first arrive. Psalm 91:11 says, "For he shall give his angels charge over thee to keep thee in all thy ways." I decree that charge activated over everyone connected to this word right now. I decree angelic escort [music] on every road you travel today. Angelic protection over every vehicle, every flight, every train, every walk from the parking lot to the front door. I decree that angels already stationed at your workplace, your school, your appointment are preparing the atmosphere before you even arrive. Softening hard hearts, arranging favorable timing, positioning you exactly where you need to be at exactly the right moment. [music] I decree over every parent sending a child into the world today, the same charge is over that child. angels go before them into that classroom, that playground, that bus, that street corner, and nothing assigned against that child today succeeds. Let us pray now against witchcraft specifically because I do not want anyone living here today naive about the reality of what operates against them. Some of you have co-workers, neighbors, even relatives who pray against your progress the way others pray for their own blessing. and I refuse to let you walk into rooms with these people unprotected. Father, I decree that every witchcraft assignment scheduled to intercept me today is scattered before it can be activated. I decree according to Numbers 23:23. There is no enchantment against Jacob, neither [music] is there any divination against Israel, that whatever plan was hatched against me overnight fails to find any resting place on my life today. Somebody declare it boldly. [music] I walk into today covered not exposed. I want to speak now about time and virtue because some of you have been losing hours of your day to things that quietly drain you. Arguments that were not necessary, distractions that were not assigned, delays that were not natural. [music] Father, I decree the redemption of my time today according to Ephesians 5:16, [music] redeeming the time because the days are evil. I decree that every hour assigned to be stolen from me by distraction, delay, or draining conversation is protected [music] today. I decree fresh strength and fresh virtue flowing into me continually so that by the time evening comes, I am not depleted. I am still carrying the same fire I started the morning with. Let us close this movement of prayer with divine preservation because everything I have prayed means very little if I am not also covered from the unexpected. [music] Father, I decree preservation over every life connected to this word today. [music] I decree according to Psalm 1217 and8, the Lord shall preserve thee from all evil. He shall preserve thy soul. The Lord shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth and even forever more. I decree safe departure this morning and safe return this evening for everyone reading and hearing this word. I want to return to preaching for a moment because there is something I have not yet said and it is important. [music] Some of you are already thinking this sounds like a lot to declare every single morning. I do not have time for a long prayer before I leave the house. [music] Let me correct that thinking gently but firmly right now. [clears throat] This is not about the length of your declaration. It is about the intention behind it. 2 Chronicles 20:20 gives us a short but complete pattern. Believe in the Lord your God, so shall ye be established. [music] Believe his prophets, so shall ye prosper. Jehoshaphat did not deliver a 40-minute sermon before that battle. [music] He positioned singers and they sang a short declaration of praise and the ambush against them [music] fell apart before Israel even lifted a sword. You do not need an hour every morning you need consistency and conviction. Even 30 seconds of decreed scripture spoken with faith while you tie your shoes or wait for your coffee to brew carries authority [music] in the spirit realm. Because it was never about duration. It was always about direction. I decree over the busy ones, the ones with three children to get ready. And a commute that starts before the sun is fully up, that even your shortest declared word this morning carries full weight in the courts of heaven. [music] God is not measuring your minutes. He's measuring your faith. Let the declarations rise again because I feel a fresh wave coming. Say this with me. whatever moment finds you reading this morning, afternoon or night, [music] because the principle applies whenever you are preparing to walk into anything unfamiliar. [music] I decree according to Psalm 143:8, "Cause me to hear thy loving kindness in the morning, for in [music] thee do I trust. Cause me to know the way wherein I should walk. I decree according to Isaiah 50:4, "The Lord God had given me the tongue of the learned that I should know how to speak a word in season to him that is weary. He wakenth morning by morning. He wakenth my ear to hear as the learned. I decree according to Lamentations 3:23 that messes are new over me this morning. And I refuse to carry yesterday's failure into a day that has already been supplied with fresh grace. I decree according to Numbers 6:24-26, [music] the Lord bless me and keep me. The Lord make his face shine upon me [music] and be gracious unto me. The Lord lift up his countenance upon me and give me [music] peace today and every day. Somebody shout it with everything left in you. I am [music] blessed before I even step outside. I sense the Holy Ghost wants to speak specifically now targeted words for particular situations. So stay alert because one of these sentences carries your name on it. Even though I do not know you personally, there is someone reading this who has an interview today or later this week. An anxiety has been building since you found out the date. The Lord says the panel will remember you long after other candidates are forgotten. walking [music] with the confidence I'm giving you right now. There is someone who has been avoiding a difficult conversation with a family member for weeks, [music] rehearsing it over and over in your mind without ever having it. The Lord says today is the day and it will go better than the version you have been dreading in your imagination. There is someone driving a long distance today, a trip that has been making you uneasy for reasons you cannot fully explain. The Lord says angels are already positioned along that entire [music] route. Travel in peace. You are covered. There is someone starting a new job this week. Nervous about fitting in, nervous about proving yourself. [music] The Lord says favor has already gone ahead of you into that building. You do not need to perform for approval. You already have it. There is someone whose morning has been hijacked by grief lately. Waking up and immediately remembering a loss before you even remember your own name. The Lord says joy is returning. According to Psalm 30:5, [music] weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning, and your morning is being scheduled for a joyful interruption. There is someone who has simply stopped believing that mornings [music] matter, who has grown numb to the idea that speaking scripture over your day changes anything at [music] all. The Lord says the numbness is lifting today. And you are about to rediscover what it feels like to walk out of [music] your house carrying fire instead of fog. Before I bring you to the final teaching, I want to pray one more specific layer over your mind. [music] Because so much of what steals a good morning is not external circumstance at all. It is internal noise. The replaying of yesterday's mistake, [music] the rehearsing of tomorrow's worst case scenario, the quiet argument you keep having with someone in your head who is not even [music] in the room. Father, in the name of Jesus, I decree the mind of Christ operating [music] in every person connected to this word this morning, according to Philippians 4:8, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report, think on these things. I decree that every intrusive thought assigned to hijack your focus before you even leave the house is silenced [music] and that your mind is stayed on him in perfect peace according to Isaiah 26:3 because it is trusting in him. I decree over the anxious one specifically [music] the ones whose stomachs tighten before every ordinary day simply out of habit built over years of disappointment. Today the pattern breaks. I decree that you walk out of your house today lighter than you have felt in months. [music] Not because the circumstances changed overnight, but because you decided this morning that your mouth would carry a different report than your feelings wanted to carry. Let a fresh shout rise here, short but fierce. My [music] mind is renewed, my mouth is loaded, and my day is already won. Let me bring you into one final teaching moment before we [music] close in prayer because I want you to live here not just emotionally moved but practically equipped. Joshua 1:8 gives us the pattern for sustained long-term success. Not just a good morning but a good life. This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth but thou shalt meditate therein day and night that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein. For then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success. Notice the order. The word stays in your mouth first. Meditation follows. Obedience follows that. And prosperity and good success are the final result. Nobody skips to [music] the last step. You cannot have the fruit of good success without first establishing the root of a mouth that consistently speaks [music] the word of God. This is why declaring scripture every morning is not a one-time hack. It is the planting of a root system that eventually produces a life so consistently blessed that people around you start asking [music] what your secret is. And your answer will be simple. Before I go out, I speak first. I do not let the day speak to me before I have spoken to it. [music] I decree this pattern establish over every life connected to this word. I decree that what starts today as a discipline becomes within weeks an instinct. Something you no longer have to force yourself to remember. Something as natural as breathing before you step outside. Now let us close in a final wave of prayer. [music] Gathering everything we have declared into one sealed decree over your day and every day that follows. Father, in the name of Jesus, we thank you for meeting us in this word. We thank you that mercy was already fresh for us before we asked for it. We thank you that our mournings no longer belong to fear, to silence, to whatever tried to claim them [music] in seasons past. I decree over every person connected to this word, your going out is blessed, and your coming in is blessed. Your mouth is loaded with scripture, not empty of it. Your steps are ordered, not scattered. Your home is peaceful, not tense. Your finances are open, not blocked. Your body is strong, not sick. Every altar assigned against you [music] is burned. Every angel assigned to you is active. Every witchcraft assignment against you is scattered. Your time is redeemed. Your virtue is renewed. and your life is preserved today, tomorrow, [music] and for as long as you keep opening your mouth before you open your front door. Let the whole house declare this final line together out loud with full conviction. Before I go out, I speak and what I speak, heaven backs in the mighty, matchless, all concrete name of Jesus Christ. So let it be. Amen. One last picture before I let you go [music] because pictures tend to stay with us longer than paragraphs do. I see in the spirit two travelers setting out on the exact same road at the exact same hour. One lives in silence, phone in hand, mind [music] still tangled in yesterday's argument, heart already bracing for whatever the day might throw at him. The other leaves with a scripture on her lips, spoken quietly but firmly as she locks her door. [music] Spoken again as she starts her car. Spoken a third time as she marges into traffic. Both travelers face the exact same conditions today. The same traffic, the same difficult coworker, the same uncertain economy, the same unpredictable weather. But only one of them has already declared the outcome before the day. had a chance to declare it for her. And [music] there is a difference, a measurable spiritual difference between a life that reacts to the day [music] and a life that speaks first and lets the day catch up. I am asking you to be the second traveler starting tomorrow, starting today. If there is still time before you walk out that door, do not let your day get the first word anymore. You get the first word because you [music] carried the authority of a covenant child of the most high God. And covenant children do not wait to see what happens before they decide what they believe. Carry this discipline with you starting tomorrow morning. And if tomorrow feels too far away, start today, right now, wherever you are. Speak Psalm 91 over your household before you leave the room you are sitting in. [music] Speak Isaiah 54:17 over your work day before you touch your phone again. Do not wait for a perfect quiet moment that may never come. Do not wait until you feel spiritual enough. Simply open your mouth and let the word out because the power was never in your feelings. [music] It was always in the word itself. And the word does not need your permission to walk. It only needs your mouth to carry it. Keep a short arsenal close at hand for mornings when the day is already pressing in and you need to arm yourself fast. Psalm 91 for covering. Isaiah 54:17 for protection against every formed weapon. Psalm 118:24 [music] for reclaiming joy over the day itself. Philippians 4:8 for guarding your mind before the noise of the world gets there first. Numbers 6:24-26. for receiving the fullness of blessing, grace, and peace. Joshua 1:8, for establishing the long-term pattern of prosperity and success. Keep these [music] close. Write them somewhere. You will see them. Speak them until they no longer feel like someone else's words borrowed for the occasion. But your own settled confession rising naturally from your spirit before your feet even touch the [music] floor. Go now and go loaded. Amen.
